text:
About contributions to the PBD Trust:

What we need is to have political parties started up all over the
planet, all sharing the same name and goals, so that we can take over
all the governments of the world and install, ideally, direct democracy,
 but definitely safeguards against corruption and oligarchy, and a
scientific method of sustainable living for everybody.

The goal needs to be discussed in the PBDT forum, and tied down to a manifesto/constitution which every party formed aspires to.

Those of you who help make this happen will be the architects of the biggest revolution which has ever happened on this planet.

You will be remembered as the heroes who saved our future.

I hope that you'll all get involved in this, not just for the
opportunity to get into the academy (and I always look after my
friends!), but because we can and must change the management of life on
this pale blue dot
